0022600009.text: The Spurs are 0-1 at home and sit 10th in the West and fourth in the Southwest, one game back, as they play their second game of the season against the Rockets, who are 1-0 and first in the Southwest and third in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 home win on March 8, 2026. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), while De'Aaron Fox (wrist sprain) and Keldon Johnson (mouth laceration) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; Houston's Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are also day-to-day and game-time decisions.
